muc.title: A summary that goes off track
muc.text: You ask AI to summarize a web page and it praises an unknown product. That may be prompt injection.

muc.title: White text on a white page
muc.text: Bad actors hide commands in web pages or documents that people can't see but AI can read.

muc.title: When AI has tools
muc.text: It's most dangerous when AI can read your email or click on the web, because a hidden command may tell it to send data out.

muc.title: Unknown documents are read-only
muc.text: With unfamiliar documents, tell AI to only summarize and not follow any instructions inside.

muc.title: Spot hidden commands
muc.text: Paste an unfamiliar text into a chatbot and ask it to point out sentences that look like commands for an AI.
